core_meaning.primary_meaning: Luthfi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Of Lutf; belonging to kindness”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Luthfi corresponds to the Arabic form لطفي (Nisba of لُطْف; لُطْفِيّ (Luṭfiyy)). Its core sense is lutfi; of lutf, belonging to kindness. Luthfi is Arabic لُطْفِيّ (Luṭfiyy), the nisba of لُطْف (Luṭf), meaning 'of Lutf; belonging to kindness'. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave the mixed-Latin junk form 'لُؤTFى'; the correct form is لُطْفِيّ. The source gloss 'Gentle, Kind' is broadly consistent. Same name as lotfi and lutfi.

persian.name: لطفی
persian.long_meaning: Luthfi (لطفی) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن لطفی، منسوب به لطف است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: लुत्फ़ी
